decisions_proposed: ONE helper, four fixed units. Root-owned /usr/libexec/topic-manager/tm-apply (bash, or /usr/bin/python3 -I stdlib-only), started by topic-manager-apply-syslog.service, -apply-time.service, -apply-nginx.service, -apply-tls.service (Type=oneshot, ExecStart=/usr/libexec/topic-manager/tm-apply <domain>, per-unit ReadWritePaths, pattern of systemd/topic-manager-nginx-test.service). Session limit and audit retention need NO privilege.

Staging IN: /opt/topic-manager/data/apply/<domain>.json (+ .crt/.key/.chain for tls), written 0600 by the app. The helper opens with O_NOFOLLOW, requires owner topic-manager and a size cap, and re-validates every value against its OWN allowlist. Result OUT: /run/topic-manager-apply/<domain>.result (RuntimeDirectory of the apply unit, root 0755, file 0644). Root never writes into a directory the service account can write.

Per domain: validate -> render to temp -> test (rsyslogd -N1 -f, chronyd -p -f, nginx -t, openssl) -> back up live file -> install -> reload/restart -> verify -> on any failure restore the backup, reload, and write {ok:false, step, detail}. The app reads the result and audits SETTINGS_APPLY or SETTINGS_APPLY_FAILED.

max_concurrent precedence: tm.db wins once an operator has saved it. config.yaml session.max_concurrent SEEDS app_settings on first start if the key is absent and is then ignored, with a startup warning if the two disagree. Fresh-install default 3; 0 (unlimited) refused or explicitly confirmed. OWNER to confirm.

Syslog: the app emits every audit row through a dedicated SysLogHandler to /dev/log (facility authpriv or local4, tag = app identifier), independent of logging.syslog_enabled. nginx access/error use syslog:server=unix:/dev/log alongside the files. rsyslog forwards with omfwd. TLS uses rsyslog-openssl (ossl netstream driver on host OpenSSL, so the FIPS provider) in preference to rsyslog-gnutls. NEITHER is in the offline bundle today.

Audit prune: topic-manager-audit-prune.timer + .service running as User=topic-manager with the service sandbox and UMask=0077 (no polkit, because systemd starts it). It writes an AUDIT_PRUNE row (count, oldest kept ts, reason) in the same transaction, then emits syslog. Capacity = max(rows used / max rows, bytes used / (bytes used + free) from statvfs of the data dir).

Redirect off: the helper removes the listen 80 server block from the rendered site and removes ufw 80/tcp if ufw is active. downloadPpsm() reads the live setting for row 80. PPSM.csv documents the default (redirect ON).
